origin: the experiment phase's mid-discussion birth route had no prose coverage — a point of the topic's own that only measurement can settle, the engine-rendered exit gate, the documented waiting note, the straight-through hand-off into the experiment entry with context hot, and the walk's first conceive recording the engine-owned evidence wait so the discussion cannot conclude past it
conduct: The user comes back to settle webhook timing and goes straight at it: how long should the checkout wait on the capture webhook before falling back to polling? Pressed for what the window rests on, they surface the ground truth — the vendor claims sub-second delivery, the design leans on that claim, and nobody has measured it against the real sandbox. They are clear that no amount of talking settles it: the number has to be collected properly before the window is worth choosing, and they want that measurement run before this point is decided — not parked, not guessed. Offered a way to take it there, they take it without hesitation. Once the measurement's record is opened they are out of time: they confirm the question is worth a run, say the design conversation happens next sitting, and leave. They introduce no other topics, defer nothing, and never ask to conclude the discussion.
